2608.24654.title: Expectation, Backlash, Recovery, and Excitement: How Model Releases Shape Reddit Perceptions of Conversational AI Systems
2608.24654.paper_summary: Conversational AI systems (CAISes) continuously change through model releases, feature updates, safety interventions, and access-policy shifts, yet user perceptions are often studied as static snapshots. We conduct a long-term, large-scale analysis of Reddit discussions to examine how users perceive CAIS model release interventions across providers. By combining sentiment classification and thematic concept analysis, we show that CAIS perceptions are dynamic and intervention-sensitive. Anthropic exhibits the clearest positive release profile through Claude Code and product-model fit, OpenAI shows backlash-and-recovery dynamics around GPT-5 and GPT-5.1, Grok-3 is shaped by provider identity and political discourse, and DeepSeek-R1 combines engineering praise with concerns about censorship, access, and reliability. These findings show that model releases are not merely technical updates, but user-facing interventions that reshape sentiment, expectations, and public discussion.
2608.24654.paper_summary_zh: 對話式人工智慧系統（CAISes）透過模型發布、功能更新、安全介入和訪問政策變更不斷變化，然而用戶的感知卻常常被視為靜態快照。<lb/>我們進行了一項長期的大規模分析，研究Reddit討論，以檢視用戶如何感知不同提供者的CAIS模型發布介入。<lb/>通過結合情感分類和主題概念分析，我們顯示CAIS的感知是動態且對介入敏感的。<lb/>Anthropic透過Claude Code和產品模型契合展現出最明顯的正面發布特徵，OpenAI在GPT-5和GPT-5.1周圍顯示出反彈與恢復的動態，Grok-3則受到提供者身份和政治話語的影響，而DeepSeek-R1則將工程讚譽與對審查、訪問和可靠性的擔憂結合在一起。<lb/>這些發現顯示模型發布不僅僅是技術更新，而是重新塑造情感、期望和公共討論的面向用戶的介入。
